title: Design resistances of existing riveted connections

group_definitions.B: Rivets installed in holes drilled in assembled elements or in individual parts using templates/jigs.
group_definitions.C: Rivets installed in holes punched or drilled without a template in individual parts.

head_rule.countersunk_or_semicountersunk: multiply shear and bearing resistances by 0.8; tension is not permitted

unknown_documentation_rule: Use group C and St2 when hole formation and rivet material cannot be established.
